economic_truth.definition: independent external buyer plus settled payment plus correct attribution plus fulfilled order plus retrievable delivery proof, reconciled to authoritative evidence

known_blockers.evidence: The repository endpoint previously allowed body.publish to publish by default.

The canonical and compiled MTG pages contained a hardcoded Stripe payment URL for Commander Deck Diagnostic while its product contract marked it held, inventory zero, checkout disabled, and fulfillment disabled. Branch patch replaces the payment button with a held status.
The repository migration contains a self-insert policy for commerce_item_ownership; a new remediation migration is staged in this branch.
A complete independently evidenced purchase-to-fulfillment-to-delivery cycle has not been verified.
Supabase SQL and advisor reads returned ECONNREFUSED for the project database endpoint.
No verified external revenue or repeatable buyer conversion has been evidenced.

Four independent app/catalog surfaces had the Commander diagnostic marked active with distinct Stripe URLs; all known application/public catalog references are being held on this branch. The actual Stripe link objects were not disabled or verified.
The .well-known and agent-commerce feeds claimed diagnostic available and EDH_0001 verified despite held canonical product/price conflict; feeds are being changed to held with no buy route.

Source product price is NZ$400 (40000 minor units), public catalog price NZ$230, and a configurator remained live-configurable. Source product, configurator, and public catalog are held pending seller-confirmed price, stock, and fulfillment.

ProductCompiler previously emitted checkout_url from commercial_truth.payment_link even when checkout was unavailable. Branch now emits a payment route/URL only when the full sellable/approved/inventory/fulfillment gate passes.

Repository metadata contains stale ACTIVE_LIVEMODE labels and multiple distinct link URLs. Actual Stripe object status remains unverified; links were not deactivated because that is a live production billing change.
Supabase SQL and security/performance advisor reads returned ECONNREFUSED. Repository branch and CI results do not prove the live deployed site/database matches the staged changes.

promotion_gates: client cannot create or mutate paid entitlements
only signed Stripe events are accepted and event processing is idempotent under concurrent retries
settlement is matched to the exact approved offer, SKU, silo, amount, currency, and buyer/session
order, fulfillment, entitlement/inventory mutation, and evidence records are transactionally consistent or safely replayable
customer can retrieve the purchased item or physical-order delivery evidence
refund, dispute, duplicate event, delayed payment, and failed fulfillment paths are tested
public listing publication requires an auditable human approval
silo identity, data, inventory, fees, credentials, and analytics remain isolated across clones
load, backup/restore, monitoring, alerting, and failure-recovery checks pass
one complete live buyer cycle is independently reconciled, followed by repeatable sales evidence
economics include fees, refunds, fulfillment cost, acquisition cost, support time, and contribution margin
CI verifies the clone contract and a clone dry-run passes without production writes

Every payment rail referenced by every API, catalog, static page, and agent-discovery feed resolves to the one approved SKU/amount/currency and is disabled in both app configuration and Stripe when the product is held; no legacy parallel payment links remain.
release_rule: No clone is promoted to production until every promotion gate has stored independent PASS evidence. UNKNOWN is not PASS. A repository-only hold does not disable a Stripe-hosted Payment Link; external Stripe state must be verified separately.
